No injury, exposed organs, blood, spray, splatter, puddle, aura, glow outline or extra appendages. Newly authored material detail, not an automatic recolor. This is not a new official species.
Composition: one complete static neutral-ready pose facing RIGHT. Side view with slight three-quarter separation only as necessary to make all limbs and appendages countable. Preserve base body proportions. Whole silhouette, every fingertip/foot/appendage tip and existing equipment visible, central 80% of image with at least 10% transparent padding all sides.
Style: detailed crisp pixel-painted/digitally shaded 2D game sprite matching the input, restrained dark contour and hard-edged material relief. Intact closed surfaces throughout.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no floor or cast shadow, no environment, gradient, halo, aura or background marks.
One figure only, no duplicates, panels, grid, contact sheet, detached body parts, motion effects, text, labels, logos, watermark, crop, extra appendages, new weapons, blood, injury or gore. Fresh original project systemic variant, not official new species, canonical-exact claim or animation.
